Faq.title: Got questions? We've got answers.
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our premium physical and digital wedding invitations.
Faq.q1: How long does an order take to complete?
Faq.a1: Turnaround time varies by product. Invitation design takes about 3–10 working days (including 5 rounds of revisions). Full production can take up to 40 working days depending on quantity and complexity.
Faq.q2: Can I request a custom design?
Faq.a2: Yes. We offer custom design services with an estimated turnaround of 5–14 working days, depending on the detail and complexity of your request.
Faq.q3: What is the minimum order quantity?
Faq.a3: The minimum order generally starts at 50 pcs for invitations. For products like hantaran and hampers, please consult your specific needs directly with our team.
Faq.a4: Payment is made in two stages — a 50% down payment upon order confirmation to begin production, and the remaining 50% before the items are handed over or shipped.
Faq.q5: Is the down payment refundable if I cancel my order?
Faq.a5: The down payment is non-refundable. Cancelling before production begins forfeits the down payment. Cancelling after production has started forfeits all payments made so far.
Faq.a6: Yes, we ship out of town via third-party couriers such as J&T or your preferred courier. Shipping costs are covered by the customer.
Faq.q7: What happens if items are damaged during shipping?
Faq.a7: Rimba is responsible for the condition of items until they are handed over to the courier. We strongly recommend shipping insurance for high-value orders to protect against risks during transit.
Faq.q8: How many design revisions do I get?
Faq.a8: Each order includes up to 5 rounds of design revisions before entering production. Revisions requested after production has started may incur additional fees.
Faq.q9: Can I see a physical sample before ordering?
Faq.a9: Of course. You can visit our gallery at Jl. Purnama, Komplek Purnama Agung 7 Blok S 32, South Pontianak, to see and feel the texture and quality of each collection in person.
Faq.q10: What other products do you offer besides invitations?
Faq.a10: We also provide pokok telur, sirih pinang, hantaran, and hampers — all of which can be customized to match your wedding theme.
Faq.q11: How do I place an order?
Faq.a11: Reach us via WhatsApp at 085750275751 or visit our gallery directly. Our team will assist you from consultation through to a price quote.
Faq.a12: Every order goes through a quality check before being handed over. If any production defect is proven to be on our part, we will fix it at no additional cost.

Reviews.title: What our couples say...
Reviews.subtitle: See stories from couples and partners who trusted Rimba for their invitations.
Reviews.r1Content: Rimba Fisik's Heartwood Series invitations completely wowed our guests. The gold hot-stamping foil was flawlessly brilliant, and the 600gsm heavy cotton paper felt extremely luxurious to the touch.
Reviews.r2Content: As a professional wedding planner, Rimba Fisik's print quality is exceptionally consistent. My clients are always amazed—from deep traditional letterpress to elegant blind debossing, the detail is incredibly precise.
Reviews.r3Content: We chose the Leaf Series with organic leaf blind debossing and it surpassed our expectations. Crisp elegant typography over natural textured linen paper—simple, eco-friendly, yet deeply memorable.
Reviews.r4Content: The custom design consulting process was incredibly smooth. The Rimba Fisik team patiently guided us to select the exact paper weight and hot stamping techniques that matched our forest wedding theme.
Reviews.r5Content: The combination of natural wooden textured accents and gold foil letterpress was breathtaking. It captured the exact rustic elegance we wanted for our wedding invitation cards. Our guests kept texting us about how beautiful they were!
Reviews.r6Content: Unbelievable tactile premium feel. We wanted an invitation that wasn't just paper, but a physical keepsake. Rimba Fisik delivered a masterwork of card design. Absolutely recommended for any couple wanting high-end invitations!
Reviews.r7Content: Minimalist layout, stark borders, and perfect hairline spacing. The typography is so clean. It's a gorgeous marriage of traditional craftsmanship and modern design sensibility.
Reviews.r8Content: We received endless compliments from friends. They said it was the most elegant invitation card they had ever held. It felt like opening a high-end exhibition card.
Reviews.r9Content: From first sketch to packaging, their team treated our cards like fine art. Rimba Fisik's commitment to perfection is unmatched. Absolute best in the print industry.
